Run Report

2026-09-08 — day lead session

Autonomous day session (10:00 → ~21:00, two usage-limit gaps): eight PRs merged, two owner questions answered and actioned, rough-glass parity opened up.

2026-09-08 · day lead session (Fable 5.1 lead; Sonnet 5 / Opus 4.8 lanes; 2 Codex Terra calls) · generated by run-report

Eight PRs landed (#754 #756 #758 #760 #761 #764 #766 #768) and a ninth (#771, rough-glass energy) is in CI with both reviewers cleared. The owner's two questions from 11:30 were answered with evidence and actioned: the "off for now" audit found the pkg224 sampler and pkg86 light tree never flipped on and GPU adaptive sampling silently inert in Blender (#759, pkg262 filed); the rough-glass limb darkening was quantified in one session (pkg263: Astroray/Cycles limb 0.81 → 0.34 across roughness) and its largest cause fixed in the next (pkg264: furnace 0.645 → 0.958, sphere bright again). Two physics defects on the most common Blender materials were root-caused and fixed with Cycles-cited ports: Principled diffuse layering (pkg261, sweep within 2.7 % of Cycles) and the Bump node's world scale (#753, 1.7× → 0.85×). The viewport Phase 2 design went through three Terra rounds and the A2 spike proved the off-thread model (GUI p50 7 ms vs 158–233 ms) while two GUI gates remain for P2.2. Parked: pkg241 P2.2 itself, the pkg262 default flips, the engine-wide rough-glass residual (#770) and the addon-zip data-table packaging gap (#769, gate (f)).

2Visual evidence

pkg263 BEFORE (r 0.85, IOR 1.45, 128 spp CPU): Cycles | Astroray | abs diff. Astroray renders the frosted sphere as a dark grey ball; Cycles bright and translucent. Limb ratio 0.34, centre 0.53.
pkg264 AFTER (same scene, PR #771 branch): the sphere is bright frosted again; centre 0.525 to 0.742, limb 0.342 to 0.556 of Cycles. Residual gap tracked as #770.
pkg263 roughness 0 (smooth glass): shape and caustic match; only the limb annulus is 19 % darker than Cycles. The r 0 loss is the addon-path residual noted in #770.
pkg258 residual diagnosis E3: the HDRI ground deficit is gated by Principled specular roughness alone (roughness 0 matches Cycles, 0.85 loses 7 %). Compare the ground-strip brightness across the sweep.
pkg261 AFTER: hdri_exterior_hair ground strip, Astroray vs Cycles: ratio 0.926 to 0.962 (blue channel 0.947 is the #767 residual). Sky strip 1.00 unchanged.
#753 BEFORE: Bump node, Distance 0.05, grazing sun. Astroray relief 1.63x Cycles (the finite-difference step was in UV units).
#753 AFTER (PR #760): 0.84x Cycles; the world-per-UV scale now multiplies the step on CPU and GPU.
pkg259 Phase 1 materials_hall (top Cycles, bottom Astroray, 128 spp CPU): layout and colours match; the shot is too wide to read (Phase 1 polish: reframe + per-alcove crops); Astroray far noisier at equal spp (#763).
pkg259 Phase 1 textures_mapping: the five procedural-texture to Emission proof cards render blank white on Astroray (#762); the sphere/swatch row matches Cycles.
